title: Scroll on run
description: Follow cells that are executed from outside the browser.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Scroll the notebook to a cell when its output changes.

alignment.title: Where to place the cell
alignment.description: Vertical placement of the cell being scrolled to. The default, 'smart', only scrolls when the cell is out of view, so running a cell you are already looking at does not move the page.

scrollOnSourceChange.title: Also follow cells as they are written
scrollOnSourceChange.description: Scroll when a cell's SOURCE changes, not just its output. Off by default: with jupytext pairing, a round-trip through the .py file can rewrite many cells at once and cause scroll storms.

debounceMs.title: Coalescing window (ms)
debounceMs.description: Streaming output fires many changes per cell. Only one scroll happens per window.
